tasks.label: go test WSL
args: cd /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go && go version && go mod tidy && go test ./... && go build ./cmd/server

tasks.label: grader self-test WSL
args: cd /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go && if [ ! -d autotests ]; then echo 'autotests directory is missing'; exit 2; fi; python3 -m pip install -r autotests/requirements.txt && make check -C autotests && make test -C autotests

tasks.label: grader self-test WSL retry
args: cd /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go && if [ ! -d autotests ]; then echo autotests_directory_is_missing; exit 2; fi; python3 -m pip install -r autotests/requirements.txt && make check -C autotests && make test -C autotests

tasks.label: run course tests WSL
args: cd /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go; go test ./...; echo COURSE_TEST_EXIT=$?; go test ./autotests/task3; echo TASK3_TEST_EXIT=$?

tasks.label: locate Go in WSL
args: echo PATH=$PATH; command -v go || true; ls -l /usr/local/go/bin/go /usr/bin/go 2>/dev/null || true

tasks.label: run course tests with Go
args: export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH; cd /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go; go version; go test ./...

tasks.label: verify project excluding grader
args: export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin; cd /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go; go test ./api ./cmd/server ./internal/... && go build ./cmd/server

tasks.label: download course autotests
args: set -e; export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH; tmp=$(mktemp -d); git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/vacmannnn/go-courses.git "$tmp/go-courses"; cd "$tmp/go-courses"; git sparse-checkout set autotests; cp -a autotests/. /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go/autotests/; rm -rf "$tmp"; find /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go/autotests -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort

tasks.label: download course autotests retry
args: set -e; tmp=$(mktemp -d); git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/vacmannnn/go-courses.git "$tmp/go-courses"; cd "$tmp/go-courses"; git sparse-checkout set autotests; cp -a autotests/. /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go/autotests/; rm -rf "$tmp"; find /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go/autotests -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort

tasks.label: download course autotests fixed
args: set -e; rm -rf /tmp/course-tests; git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/vacmannnn/go-courses.git /tmp/course-tests; cd /tmp/course-tests; git sparse-checkout set autotests; cp -a /tmp/course-tests/autotests/. /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go/autotests/; rm -rf /tmp/course-tests; find /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go/autotests -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort

tasks.label: run downloaded autotests
args: export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin; cd /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go/autotests; go mod tidy; make check; make test

tasks.label: run grader after repair
args: set -e; PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; export PATH; cd /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go; python3 -m pip install --user -r autotests/requirements.txt; cd autotests; make check; make test

tasks.label: grade current task3 solution
args: set -e; PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; export PATH; cd /mnt/c/Users/user/Desktop/go; python3 autotests/scripts/ci.py --repo . --task 3 --module . --package ./cmd/server --report /tmp/course-report.json
